scenario: A match is written in `where`, never in `let` ([LREG.4.1]), whatever its capture profile. Pin: `let x = m.text ~ /abc/` — a capture-free match bound to a plain `let` name — rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_CAPTURE_IN_LET. Path: `dsc.validate.lreg_4_1_let` over every match in the `let`'s right-hand side.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule trig:
    Msg m
->
    let x = m.text ~ /abc/
    log info "{x}"
